title: Vanishing of higher cohomology on affines
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent
$\mathcal O_X$-module. For any affine open $U\subset X$ we have
$\mathrm H^p(U,\mathcal F)=0$ for all $p>0$.
(*Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.2.2, Tag
[01XB](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01XB).*)

proof.text: Write p=q+1 using p>0. Regard U as its induced scheme, with IsAffine U supplied by hU. Restrict F along U.ι; Mathlib’s isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor gives quasi-coherence of this restricted module.
Apply [lem-pc-affine-vanishing] to the restricted module on the affine scheme U. This gives Subsingleton of its underlying abelian-sheaf cohomology in degree q+1.

Use [lem-pqf-open-module-cohomology-comparison] to obtain an additive equivalence from the displayed module-derived open cohomology to the group in Step 2. Its injectivity transports equality of any two elements, proving the displayed Subsingleton.
